title: Mirror
rule: All lettering is mirror-reversed; the page reads true in a mirror.
declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome
build: films/swarm/99-ways/build/p63_mirror.py (stencil kit: build/p08_lipogram.py; figure model build/b1m2.py)

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

made: six panels printed as HANDMADE stencils in flat dyes with page 08's kit (one cut stencil per dye with paper ties, misregistration, mottle, edge pooling) from the b1m2 cut model; the ANRC 1922 key cutout as an ochre stencil; on the LoC 1934 sheet
captions, the four canon lines in the shared cut-paper balloons, MEMO, TICKET OFFICE and the SERVICE card and tag, all in the shared pen hand

the page is composed the right way round and printed reversed as a whole (the ink mirrored left to right, the sheet's fibre kept): every word and the reading order of the panels come true only in a mirror; the folio line alone is printed the right way (pen99.folio after reversal)

events.E0: P1 (top band): memo slip on the desk, agent rising; cupboard and SERVICE door beyond
events.E1: P2: lady at the TICKET OFFICE window; question
events.E4: P5: cupboard opened, key on its hook tagged SERVICE
events.E5: P6: forgetting line; key on its hook; SERVICE door shut

beat: the reversed page is printed dye by dye and lettered backwards; then a mirror slides across it and the page comes true under the glass
beat_frames: b06: a mirror slid over the left 38%: the page reads true under the glass
b08: the whole page as the mirror shows it

self_check.check: Outside the folio line, every word reads correctly only in a mirror: structurally verified (the whole composed page, lettering included, is flipped left-right after composition; only pen99.folio is drawn afterwards); verified by viewing the flipped JPEG, in which every caption, balloon, MEMO, TICKET OFFICE and SERVICE read true
self_check.pending: independent blind reading not run by the maker

weaknesses: the pictures are reversed too, so the panel order runs right to left on the page; a reader without a mirror has to start at the top right
the clock's face is mirrored as well, so on the page itself it reads 7:50; true (4:10) only in the mirror
the beat frames' 'mirror' is a wipe showing the reflected page in place, not a physically placed mirror
